name: Neural Crown of Command - Leverage Charge

system.description:
Cyber Cost: 3

When you roll with Hope using an Influence card or in a social context, gain 1 Leverage Charge, max 3. Before a roll using your Presence or Influence card, spend any Charges to add +1 per charge to the roll. If you succeed, a target also marks the same number of Stress and one ally who can hear you clears the same number of Stress for every charge spent.
